script:e_eq_500003_x9v3rpd7_00_script_te:
The Pillar Men have implanted Joseph with
poison-filled "Wedding Rings of Death."

The antidote can only be had by defeating the Pillar Men...!
But Joseph, as he is now, is no match for them...
That part's a relief, at least...
Train together with Josuke and Jotaro!

Clear Quests to get rare items
and Diamond Coins!!

To train, the two set out for Venice, Italy,
home of Caesar's Hamon master...!

Whaaaat the heck!?
Isn't this Venice place supposed to be a tourist town?

You there... A gondola, please.
We wish to go to Air Supplena Island.
A "rat hunt," huh... Sounds kinda "gross," but...

Being around Jotaro makes me feel
kinda "proud," y'know...

damage whoever attacked you, so make
good use of counters to bring them down!

script:e_ev_eq_500000_i7rf9d5a_00_script:
A rat that has become a Stand user is lurking in Morioh!
Sensing the danger, Jotaro sets out on a "hunt" with Josuke.

The rat will probably run off before
it comes within a Stand's range...

Being around Jotaro makes me feel
kinda "proud," y'know...
That part's a relief, at least...

In this event, all sorts of enemies
will challenge you!

...Now, train for battle
with Josuke and Jotaro!

With that in mind, Jotaro decides to teach Josuke
how to take the rat down from long range.
Before you meet the rat, train to defeat it!

This "hunt"... for the rat...
You don't mean "catch" it, you mean "kill" it...?

I'd rather catch it if we can... but it isn't human.
It depends on the target... There's no telling how it'll go.
A "rat hunt," huh... Sounds kinda "gross," but...
script:e_ev_eq_500000_i7rf9d5a_01_script:
If I flick this ball bearing...
It's not quite a pistol or a rifle, but...
it can punch a hole in something up to about 20 meters away...

Of course, it won't work on a Stand...
It's only for taking out the user...
script:e_ev_eq_500000_i7rf9d5a_02_script: Whoa! The second one was so close!

Hm. Not bad.
I'd give it 85 points.
script:e_ev_eq_500000_i7rf9d5a_03_script: One word of warning before we start tracking.

With a living creature, put "staying calm"
ahead of "speed."

If you spot that "rat" within range
and then miss,

that "rat" will never come within
our range again.
Don't fire until you're sure it'll hit.
Not that I'm trying to put pressure on you...

Well, you sure put
the pressure on...
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_00_script:
On their journey to defeat DIO, the group
stops for the night in a town thick with fog.

The old woman who led them to the hotel
was the mother of the DIO assassin Polnareff defeated:

A hundred, a thousand, I can control them all!
Hyahahahaha hyahyahya!

All I need is to make the tiniest wound on your body!
Just the tiniest!

And then my Stand Justice
will kill you!

J. Geil's mother, Enyaba, has a Stand that can
control the dead and the wounded...!

Enyaba even takes control of Hol Horse, her son's partner,
and tries to kill him...!
And now the dangerous Enyaba sets her sights on Polnareff...!
This is the power of my Stand, Justice!

Each person has only one Stand! But!
Justice is a Stand of fog that controls corpses!
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_01_script:
Waaah! Polnareff!
Don't leave me behind!

Shut up, Hol Horse!
Have you forgotten what happened to Avdol!?

I've got no reason to save you!
Just die right there, you bastard!

You won't escape me, Polnareeeff!
I'll rip your brains right out!

I'll snap your spine in two!
I'll crush your balls flat!
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_02_script:
I don't think I'd lose fighting alone,
but if they so much as scratch me, I'm in trouble!

I'd end up with a hole in me like Hol Horse
and be under her control.
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_03_script:
Quit playing dumb.
We already know you're one of the Stand users
sent after us, you old hag.

Well? What's wrong?
Aren't you going to show us your Stand?

Oh, great... Now that I look, this room's a toilet!?
Why do I always get attacked in places like toilets!?

But the moment they come in,
my Chariot will, in a single breath,
slice four of them to pieces!!

Weeell now!
How about you clean the toilet for me...?
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_04_script:
Can a fist knock down fog!?
Can a sword cut fog!?

Can a gun destroy fog!?
It's useless! Useless! Kyakya kekeee!

Good grief.
There's no need to run...

I'll take down that Stand
before the old hag takes one more breath.
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_05_script:
Whaaat!? One more what!?
You stinking, rotten little punk!!

One breath, you say!? I'll take one right now...
...One...

So what does it matter where I licked!?
That's not important, is it!?
Huh? Where did you lick? I didn't quite catch that.

Who cares where!?
Just give me some medicine to disinfect my tongue already!
Just now, I thought I heard something like... toilet...

Pfft, pfft... Actually, we already know.
How could I not tease you about something this funny?

Ah! Don't tell me...
You already heard from Jotaro!

Dammit! Hmph, forget the medicine!
Dammit... Come on! Let's hurry on with the journey, Jotaro! Kakyoin!

Jotaro's Star Platinum has sucked in the head
of Justice, the fog, and is holding it down!

Well, well.
Looks like this old hag's head
is now full of that fog she loves so much.
script:e_ev_eq_500001_n596dgm4_06_script:
In this event, corpses controlled by Enyaba
and other enemies attack one after another!

Defeat them to earn points!
...Now, the battle in the eerie town of fog begins!
script:e_ev_eq_500002_j7q4m2xv_00_script:
Troubled by her love for Koichi, Yukako learns
of a mysterious shop from Joseph.
c380cd0e
"Makeup to Help You Find Love" - Cinderella -

When it comes to love, you now have
an "invincible body"...
6a2f1cd8

They say the makeup of the shop's owner, a woman named
Aya Tsuji, can change your fortune in love...
aa5f58c6

Half in doubt, Yukako tries a makeover
that changes her fortune for just 30 minutes.
And then she ends up having tea with Koichi at a cafe!

Things go well with Koichi, but 30 minutes pass
and the makeup's power fades...

Yukako rushes back to the shop
and demands that Aya Tsuji do her makeup again!

The fortune-changing makeup was Aya Tsuji's Stand ability...!
Even so, Yukako doesn't care and undergoes the treatment.

I see, so it was a "Stand ability"...
But come to think of it, it doesn't matter.

Your beauty skills are the real thing...
I trust you. You're a magician...
script:e_ev_eq_500002_j7q4m2xv_01_script:
Ah, now that I look... this is Yukako's bag...
I must've taken it by mistake...
Oh no! I have to go back and return it!

I'm heading to Kameyu Department Store to take
reference photos for my work...

It'll only take an hour.
Taking photos alone in a department store is embarrassing, right?

Mr. Joestar!

As far as I, Speedwagon, can tell,

Mr. Joestar has mastered Mr. Zeppeli's Hamon,

But Dio's power is unmatched, enough to

It'll be decided in an instant! The moment they pass
each other, it should all be over!!
I'll wring it out of you! Your life!
I'll purify it! Your defiled ambition!
In his final moments, Zeppeli entrusts his secret technique, and his hopes, to Jonathan...

Carrying Zeppeli's death in his heart, and to settle everything at last,

Don't get cocky! KUAAH!
Every last one of you! You're food for the dead!
I'll make a meal of those pale faces!
I, Straizo, will show no mercy!

His hands! His hands are on fire! He set his gloves alight!!

But why is he crying

But me? I'm gonna laugh out loud!
We finally did it! Dio is dead!
It may be an exaggeration, but the world has been saved!

Which of us will fall in the end...
We're about to find out, Dio!!

Th-this can't be! Oh... Ohh!
My body! My body is melting!

Sensing danger, Polnareff, Iggy and Avdol

If there's no signal from us in 10 minutes...
set the mansion on fire! Got it... Avdol...!

Forgive me for disturbing your rest.

I must also report that D'Arby has been defeated.

He had the skill to win,
so why do you think D'Arby lost?

And so, just a hair short,

D'Arby will never understand why he lost...
Ice, look at the wound on my neck.

Most likely, once I drink the blood of one more person,
this body of Jonathan Joestar, which hasn't taken to me,

Ice, will you give me your blood?
To cut off your own head... I am pleased...

I cannot accept the blood of one such as you...

I shall heal my wound completely
with someone else's.

You need not die...
Be revived by my blood...

Lord... DIO...
Your expectations shall be met...

I shall surely finish them off...
for you... to see...

The Joestars...
to save a daughter... or a mother,

are willing, from the depths of their hearts, to throw away their lives.
Even Kakyoin and the other two... let's see...

...Yes... Even Avdol and Polnareff,
to defeat me, DIO,

are willing to trade away their own lives.
They believe that running from me, DIO,

means running from their own lives...
...It's foolish, but...

that foolishness is surprisingly important.
D'Arby swore his loyalty, and yet

he was not prepared to die
for me, DIO...

We're going in, Polnareff.
All right, we're going in! Avdol! Iggy!

! The flame's reacting already.

Polnareff, before we go in, there's one thing I must say.
If, inside this mansion,

(Wh-what on earth is this thing!?

you go missing or get injured,

Where did you go!?

Such an arrogant notion as defeating Lord DIO...

One by one, in order, one after another,

I, Vanilla Ice, will scatter you

It's a cold way to think,
but we've made this journey to defeat DIO...

And you two as well... if I'm taken down...
or if we get separated...

promise me you won't try to help me.
Put your own safety first...

We must not get wiped out

Yeah, got it... Avdol.
If we make it out alive, you're treating me to a fancy dinner.

Dammit, Avdol...
You! You're the one who said it...

Iggy! Watch my back!
I've got yours!
Come at me from anywhere! Dammiiit!!

Whaaat!?
Th-the groove under my feet...!

First, I took your feet!
So you can't scurry around or run away!

"Put your own safety first" if anything happened,
"don't help me," you said... You liar...

Ever since India, you've always been
doing things you didn't have to!)

Avdol! You! You should've just
left me alone!
(If I hadn't happened to crouch just now... I'd be dead...

Staying in this room is bad news!
script:e_ev_eq_500063_swd109eg_04_script:
Therefore! No matter what happens,

I'll kick you to death!
You miserable beast!

Iggy!

your sand gave me a hint, and I've figured out

Answer 2: His friends come to save him.
Answer 3: He can't dodge. Reality is cruel.

My Silver Chariot is a Stand that slashes with a sword!

Hauling my body weight with brute strength

Hide in the sand and play dead!

Tch! One more lap and he'll crash right here.

Reality's not that kind.
So long, Iggy.

Dammit! Damn it! He saw through it!

I only just realized
that I liked this guy...

I never realize until they're gone.

I told him not to save me... D-dammit!

The real Lord DIO would never come down

The real Lord DIO placed his trust in me

with his own shovel driven into his head...

He won't regain consciousness like that. He's in critical condition.
I'm looking into who did it!
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_01_script:
One of our own got hurt,
so the boss feels he's been humiliated.

So he ordered me to find out who did it
and settle the score.

It's Luca's right eye...
He's unconscious anyway, so I brought it along...

This taste! This is the taste of a liar...
Giorno Giovanna!

I have a question for you... At the airport,
did you meet "Leaky Eye Luca"?

No... I don't know anyone...
called "Leaky Eye Luca"...

You're not sweating...
All right, I believe you... That's all I wanted to ask...
Sorry to bother you... Giorno Giovanna.
(What is this!? I was holding his hand...!!)
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_02_script:
I said that was all I wanted to ask...
but the situation has changed...

Giorno Giovanna, you lied!
So why did you lie?

If you don't talk soon, the torture will continue!
Giorno Giovanna!

Now I have no choice
but to make you tell me why...

My name is Bruno Bucciarati.
Answer me. This questioning has already become torture.

That's Luca's finger.
Truth is, I had "Leaky Eye Luca" taken care of.
There was no point in him living on like that.

Besides my talent for spotting lies, I can even fit
that fire extinguisher over there inside your mouth.
Though if I did that, you'd die...
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_03_script:
(I've never once attacked a human
with Gold Experience...!

If I attack a living human...!?
Even I can't predict what will happen!)

(I only think I'm moving
with tremendous power...

That over there is my body...
and only my consciousness has flown out and is here!?)

It seems that if I give a living human
even more life with Gold Experience...

it runs wild...
only their senses do...

You're someone who has come prepared... right?
If you set out to take care of someone,

then you must always be prepared for the risk
that you might be taken care of instead...

(He's going to kill me... He means it...
Just a kid, and he's trying to take care of me...
When he says he'll do it, he does it...)

No one told me to bring the culprit back alive...
I've had enough of risking contact with your freakish ability...

I'll back off a little... Once I've put some distance between us,
I'll take care of you.

(His zippers... don't tell me!
Can he get inside a person, too?
Which one!? Which one is he hiding in!?)

I gave life to the tooth of yours I broke earlier
and had it reborn as a fly...

The fly would fly back to you,
so I could tell which one you were...

It can't be helped... It means taking a risk...
but it looks like I have to do it, here and now...
Your movements look slow to me!

Is this because I got hit
by your ability!?

Wh-What!?
There's me! I'm behind myself!
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_04_script:
"My fist landed first"... so why?
It's only natural that you'd think that.

This isn't my arm.
It belongs to the kid over there,

the one I just hid inside...
I swapped his arm for mine and attached it.
Wanting to eliminate as much as possible the risk

of being hit by your ability
is only a natural desire, after all.

Now I'll take care of you!
Giorno Giovannaaa!
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_05_script:
What are you doing?
Giorno Giovanna!

Why did you stop attacking me!?
Why don't you finish me off?

That's why seeing his arm
hurt your heart...

...And what if it did?
Just because you decided to stop attacking...

doesn't change the fact
that I'm going to kill you!

No. You won't kill me now.
Because... you're going to join me.

To wipe out gangsters who push drugs on children,
I have to become a gangster myself.

To take over this city, there's no other way
than to join the organization that rules it and rise to the top.
I'm going to become a Gang-Star!

...Because you're a good person.
A gangster, but a good person...

Just now, you hesitated for an instant before attacking me,
so I decided to stop attacking you, too.
When you saw this boy's arm, the one you took off yourself...

you noticed what was wrong with it, and the shock
made you stop your attack for an instant...
That's why I decided to stop attacking.

...In this city, there are people who sell drugs to children.
You won't forgive people like that...

But the one selling the drugs is your own boss.
And you feel the contradiction in that...
script:e_ev_eq_500067_166aw0ov_06_script:
Bucciarati, a young gangster, is searching
for the one who attacked Luca...

script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_00_script:
Though only for a moment,
Jotaro managed to enter DIO's world of stopped time...!

He landed a blow on DIO, but DIO drank blood again
and recovered...!!

Of all things...!
This descendant of the Joestars...

has entered...
"my world of stopped time"...!!

Luring you in with the magnet trick
and letting you have it worked out fine, but...

unless I blow your head to smithereens,
it looks like it doesn't do much...
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_01_script:
Your eyes followed me...
in the stopped world...

It seems you can clearly see my, DIO's, movements...
Jotaro...

Heh! Naturally, you don't want to say.
But if you ask me, you can probably
still only move for an instant...

But... now that you've entered
the world of stopped time,

underestimating you and getting close
would not be a wise thing to do.
Even if I still have an overwhelming advantage...

I've thought of an execution that won't matter
how many seconds you can move...
You've gone pale... With your sharp instincts, you've realized it...

Kakyoin did a fine job, didn't he...?
Thanks to Kakyoin solving the mystery of my The World,

you became "aware" of moving in stopped time...
and were able to enter my world.

Just how long can you move
in the stopped world?

Can you move for 5 seconds, like me,
and are only pretending you can't...?

(With a little more practice, I could probably move longer...
but right now... an instant is all I can manage...

If he finds out I can only move for an instant,
it's all over...)
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_02_script:
When time begins to move again, no matter how
much you block with Star Platinum's barrage...

Heh heh heh... So it's proven...
that you can only move for an instant...

can you really knock away
every last one of those knives...?

Heh heh heh... Being able to see it
only makes it more terrifying.
If you don't move now and swat these knives away,
you'll be in trouble once time starts moving again... Jotaro!!
2 seconds left! Is that it...? Is that all you can move?
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_03_script:
He threw a ton of them...
I was wary of projectiles, so to be safe, I picked up
some magazines and stuffed them in my hat and chest...
This is the finishing blow, Jotaro!

He thinks he finished me off, so for now...
I'll "play dead" and lie low...

and wait for my chance...
That seems like the best plan...

Somehow, I've gotta blow his head off...
or he won't die...

I suppose I should make doubly sure.
The Joestar bloodline is a lucky one, after all.
He might be playing dead to fool me.
By cutting off his head... with this.
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_04_script:
You're alive...? Or...
did you come back to life...?

His breathing...
I can't hear it... He's not breathing...

His heart has stopped...
He is completely dead.
I only imagined he was alive.

Just in case, I'll cut off his head
so I can be truly certain. Right, Jotaro?

Just a moment more... Just a tiny bit
more strength, and you could have

stirred up this brain tissue
and destroyed it...
No one can assassinate me, DIO...

(Dammit...
At this rate, Polnareff's gonna get killed...)

I meant to play dead as long as I could
and wait for my chance at one blow to the head, but...
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_05_script:
I went through a lot for this... Stop time if you want,
I'm putting a fist right through your head... DIO!!
Finally managed to smash one right into the top of his head.
script:e_ev_eq_500069_w8er5jgm_06_script:
Even if you attack DIO, unless you blow his head off,
he'll just recover again...!

Wait for your chance at one blow to the head
and defeat DIO with all your might...!
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_00_script:
Giorno told Bucciarati of his dream
to become a Gang-Star and make the city peaceful.

To take the gang's entrance test,
he goes to meet the capo, Polpo.

Giorno was told to bring back a lighter
without letting its flame go out for 24 hours.

An unexpected accident put out the flame, and when it was relit,
Polpo's Stand, Black Sabbath, attacked!

He defeated Black Sabbath and passed the lighter test,
becoming a member of the gang and one of Bucciarati's men.

After passing, Giorno killed Polpo,
who dragged innocent people into it, making it look like suicide.
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_01_script:
Come on, Fugooo... The weather's so nice out...
I can skip studying for just one day...
I'm just not feeling it today...
Hey, what's the big idea here!?
? What do you mean? It's strawberry cake.
I can see that it's strawberry cake!

It's not chocolate cake,
and it's not cheesecake, either.

That's not the point! There are FOUR slices!
Are you telling me to die!?

Idiot! Picking one thing
out of four is bad luck!

Picking out of five is fine!
Picking out of three is fine, too!

But if you pick out of four,
something bad's gonna happen!

Look, Narancia, you're admirable.
You never properly went to elementary school,
and it's not easy to say "teach me" on your own...

And you learned your multiplication tables
just fine, didn't you?

If you do it the way I taught you, you can do it.
You can do it...
6 times 5... six fives... six fives, uh... 30?

Yes! See, you can do it!
You're already halfway there!
Oh yeah! Six fives are 30! All right!
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_02_script:
Talking down to people isn't nice!
I'll kill you! I'm gonna kill you, Fugo!
You idiots! What are you doing!?

I brought the new member I told you about yesterday!
This is Giorno Giovanna!!

I'm Giorno Giovanna.
A pleasure to meet you.
Heh heh, did I get it right?

Are you mocking me, you punk!?
How many times do I have to teach you before you get it!?

You wrote six fives are 30,
so why'd the answer go below 30, you...

Aaand he snapped again.
Hey, Abbacchio, you gonna leave that cake? Or eat it?

What did you say...?
You called me rotten-brained...!
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_03_script:
Sorry, Fugo. I'll study really hard.
So teach me again, OK?
I'm the one who should apologize, Narancia.

No sense standing around. Have a seat here.
Have some tea... let's have a little chat...

I went out of my way to pour that for you,
and you said, "Thank you, I will."

Since you said you would, you'd better drink it.
Or is it too lukewarm for you?

Or maybe you don't wanna drink it
because you don't wanna be one of us?

Hey, you guys! I'm the one who brought him here,
so be nice to him!
Mr. Bucciarati, there's a phone call for you.

Ah, got it.
You guys make sure to say hello to Giorno properly, understand?
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_04_script:
No way! Hey! That's gross!
He drank it! This guy actually drank it!
Quit fooling around, you guys. We're heading out.
You'll see if you follow me. Hurry up.

Bucciarati?
That phone call just now... did something happen?

No! There's no way he drank it!
Hey, how'd you do it!? Where'd you hide it!?

Did you really drink it!? Tell me!
Just me! Come on, tell me!

Who knows...
You keep your abilities secret too, don't you?

I turned one of my teeth into a jellyfish, whose body is 98% water,
and had it soak it all up.
I don't really understand it, but Giorno Giovanna...

seems to have some kind of talent
for winning people over.
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_05_script: Ooh! So heading out means a cruise! Sweet!

Hey, Bucciarati,
when did you get your hands on a yacht?

It doesn't matter why he died.
Polpo was a capo who did things that got him what he deserved...

But what does that have to do
with Capri?

The truth is, Polpo had a hidden fortune.
And it's worth... 10 billion lire!

I'm the only one who knows where it's hidden!
Because Polpo ordered me to hide it!

The 10 billion is ours.
With that money, I can become a capo!

Hey, Bucciarati! Come on already!
Can't you tell us where this boat is headed!?
All right. We're far enough from land now.
We're headed for Capri! Polpo has killed himself!
script:e_ev_eq_500070_6s5766gd_06_script:
Now one of Bucciarati's men, Giorno
goes to meet the rest of the team.
What kind of people will they be...!?

script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_00_script:
Hamon cannot be used without mastering
a special breathing technique...!!

All Hamon warriors go through harsh training...!
Train in Hamon and gain its power!
script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_01_script:
Let me show you the energy that breathing creates.
This is a method of controlling the body that I, Zeppeli, have studied for years.
The people of the East call it "Sendo."
Wh-What is he going to do!?

This is Sendo!
Hamon energy is the power of Sendo!!

My Hamon energy traveled through the frog's body
as a ripple, and shattered the rock!!
script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_02_script:
JoJo! Go defeat him without spilling
a single drop of that wine from the glass!!

Spill even one drop of that wine!
Then, even if you defeat him...

I understand...
"The north wind made the Vikings," right?
script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_03_script:
Now that I've tested you,
I can see your talent is remarkable.

I'm impressed you can move that well
on the water without any training...

I am not teaching you the "Hamon technique"
to save your life.

I am teaching you to make you a warrior who will defeat them!
...Remember that!

However! To reach a full-fledged level in one month,
you must be "prepared to die"!

For one month, you must live your life
wearing that "Breathing Correction Mask."

JoJo! Steady your rhythm!
Then it'll be no worse than a mask for a cold.
And there is one more thing I must tell you.
script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_04_script:
Ah! I... I can do it! I can keep the water in
an upside-down cup perfectly still!

Incredible! ...JoJo... In just 3 days,
he's learned to control his Hamon...

JoJo's talent is remarkable, but even more remarkable
is the effect of Lisa Lisa's training!

Teacher! I-I'm so moved!
H-hurry up and move on to the next training!
I-I'll overcome anything you throw at me!

Even if you hadn't asked, I've prepared plenty of
training for you... Feel free to be moved to death.
script:e_ev_eq_500072_0x80dsqy_05_script: Learn to take 10 breaths per second!!

Next, breathe in for 10 minutes straight,
then breathe out for 10 minutes straight!
Do that, and we'll take off the mask.

Jotaro in the infirmary?

(1) A marionette
(2) A handkerchief
(3) Oil painting supplies
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_07_script:
-> The answer is (1) A marionette!
The handkerchief is what Kakyoin handed Jotaro
when they first met at the shrine.

The one holding the handkerchief with the challenge
in the infirmary was Jotaro!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_08_script:
In DIO and Jotaro's final battle,
DIO tries to crush Jotaro with a steamroller!
At what second of his count did he try to crush him?
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_09_script:
-> The answer is (2) 7 seconds!
I'll finish this within the 9 seconds of stopped time!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_10_script: Where was Kakyoin's Flesh Bud embedded?

(1) Between the eyebrows
(2) The forehead
(3) The corner of the eye
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_11_script:
-> The answer is (2) The forehead!
Right around the hairline!
When pulling out a Flesh Bud, be careful it doesn't enter the brain!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_12_script:
How much does one of the Polaroid cameras cost that Joseph
uses for spirit photography, which led them
to find DIO's hideout?
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_13_script:
-> The answer is (2) 30,000 yen!
He has to smash one every time he takes a spirit photo!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_14_script:
When Tower of Gray attacked Jotaro's group,
which fingers of his right hand did Kakyoin raise
as he struck back, saying "Is that so?"

(1) Index finger and pinky
(2) Thumb, index finger and pinky
(3) Thumb and index finger
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_15_script:
-> The answer is (3) Thumb and index finger!
Thumb, index finger and pinky are on the left hand...!
Strike the pose and see for yourself!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_16_script:
When DIO lost his leg fighting Jotaro
in the streets of Egypt, he told a woman nearby

to bring him his leg "the way a stewardess serves
___ and ___ to a first-class passenger."
Which words fill in the blanks?

(1) Caviar and wine
(2) Dinner and champagne
(3) Liquor and caviar
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_17_script:
-> The answer is (3) Liquor and caviar!
Carry severed legs with grace and care!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_18_script:
What awful thing happened to Kakyoin
in Calcutta, India?

(1) His wallet was stolen
(2) Someone wiped snot on him
(3) He stepped in cow dung
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_19_script:
-> The answer is (1) His wallet was stolen!
The other two happened to Polnareff.
Avdol: "That's what makes it great! This, right here!"
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_20_script:
DIO sends a car careening through the streets of Cairo
to chase Kakyoin and the others.
Who did he order to drive it?

(1) Senator Wilson Phillips
(2) Councilman Wilson Phillips
(3) Representative Wilson Phillips
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_21_script: -> The answer is (1) Senator Wilson Phillips!

He owns a sprawling villa in Hawaii
and pays 50 times more taxes than other people,
but DIO threatened him into driving the car wild.
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_22_script:
After Avdol fell to J. Geil, Kakyoin saved
Polnareff, who had taken the bait.

Afterward, what did he do to Polnareff
instead of shaking hands to make up?

(1) Bumped fists
(2) Hit him with his elbow
(3) Kicked him
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_23_script:
-> The answer is (2) Hit him with his elbow.
He got hit so hard that
Polnareff had a huge nosebleed!!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_24_script:
One of DIO's underlings tried to attack DIO.
Who was it?
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_25_script:
-> The answer is (2) Hol Horse!
Nukesaku led Jotaro and the others to DIO's room,
but he didn't attack him...!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_26_script:
What time was it in Cairo when Kakyoin
was fatally wounded fighting DIO?
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_27_script:
-> The answer is (2) 5:15. Thinking about the time, he hit on a "strange question"...!
He had uncovered the true nature of DIO's ability!
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_28_script:
When DIO awakened to his power to stop time,
Enyaba compared it to something as natural as
snapping a ___ pencil in two. What kind?

(1) A 2B pencil
(2) An H pencil
(3) An HB pencil
script:e_ev_eq_500084_pih3iqdg_29_script:
-> The answer is (3) An HB pencil!
Of course anyone can snap a pencil!
Try practicing snapping pencils...!

script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_08_script:
This High Score Quest is an event where you compete
for the total damage dealt to all enemies!

The number of turns to clear doesn't affect your score!
Plan your strategy and deal massive damage!
script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_09_script:
The keys to a high score are
"Chains" and "Status Effects"!

A "Chain" happens when allies
act in a row!
The more Chains, the more damage and healing!

At 4 Chains or more,
damage and healing are doubled!
script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_10_script: To build up your Chain count,

skills that raise Speed, like those of
Santana and Leone Abbacchio,

and skills with short Skill Wait, like those of
Yukako Yamagishi and Jean Pierre Polnareff, are effective!

You can also activate Reversal Mode
to raise your Speed!

Trish Una's Reflect Counter,
the counters of Giorno Giovanna and others,

and sealing enemy actions with the Action Seal
of Mariah and Enyaba also build your Chain count!
script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_11_script: "Status Effects" are also key to a high score!

Statues with enemy DEF Down skills
or ally ATK Up skills,
such as Lisa Lisa and Akira Otoishi, are effective!
script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_12_script:
If you meet the clear conditions in Reversal Mode
in the Quest's final Area,
an "Overkill" occurs!

You can follow up on the enemy
and deal even more damage!
script:e_ev_eq_500085_x46svos4_13_script: This time, in every stage of the [High Score Quest],

Mariah, Enyaba, Lisa Lisa,
Yukako Yamagishi and Trish Una
get an ATK Up effect!

You can expect more damage than usual,
so add them to your team!

script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_02_script:
This stage's boss resists
Pierce Skills and uses
DEF Up Skills back to back!

If you don't whittle its HP down enough by a certain turn,
it will unleash an extremely powerful attack!

[Damage Over Time] Skills, which deal
damage regardless of DEF, are effective!
script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_03_script: This stage features tough enemies one after another!

In Area 1, a high-DEF enemy
uses DEF Up on its whole team!
Finish it off fast with Piercing attacks!

In Area 2, an enemy appears that uses
ATK Up on its whole team!

The enemy that uses ATK Up has high Evasion,
so take it on with high-Accuracy Statues!

Fighting while removing ATK Up with skills
that remove Status Effects (buffs) is also effective!

The Area 3 Boss gains Evasion and Speed
as its HP drops!

Get set up while the Boss's HP is high,
then take it down all at once when its HP drops!
script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_04_script:
This stage features a Boss with high-DR attacks!
High-DR attacks are dangerous attacks
that also raise its ATK and DEF!

It targets Statues with high HP,
so fight back by using counters
with high-HP Statues!

"Reflect Counter" can counter both melee
and multi-hit attacks!
It's shown when the enemy attacks, so check carefully!
script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_05_script:
This stage features enemies
that use time-stopping skills!

They use stat-boosting skills
while time is stopped!

Use your own Statues with time-stopping skills
to defeat them before they boost their stats!
script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_06_script:
This stage's boss unleashes powerful
long-range attacks back to back!

Take it on with Statues that have Skills that
counter long-range attacks, DEF Up Skills
or Skills with an Armor effect!

Especially recommended is
the new Statue Ghiaccio ★6!
script:e_ev_eq_500086_61nnxq09_07_script:
This stage features many enemies
that use powerful counterattacks!

If a counter lands, you'll take heavy damage!
And you won't be able to damage the enemy, either...!

There are melee counters and ranged counters,
so fight back by choosing
the right kind of attack!

script:e_ev_eq_500088_3y7hqx2a_03_script:

your score is "the total damage dealt
from the start of the stage until you clear it"

plus "the highest damage dealt
to the Boss in one hit"!

and "highest damage to the Boss in one hit" (MAX Damage)

Save your strong attacks for the final Boss,
while still aiming for big damage
against the other enemies!

script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_00_script:
A "Chain" happens when allies act
in a row!
The more Chains, the more damage and healing!

At 4 Chains or more,
damage and healing are doubled!

The key to a high score is
how well you can build Chains!
script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_01_script:
Attacking enemies and taking damage
fill the Reversal Gauge!

When the gauge is full, press [R] in the center of the screen
to activate [Reversal Mode]!

During Reversal Mode, Statue speed and
Cool Turn reduction increase,
making it easier to act in a row!
script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_02_script:
And if you meet the clear conditions
during Reversal Mode in the Quest's final Area,
an "Overkill" occurs!

During an "Overkill," you can keep attacking enemies
even after defeating them! Since they don't go down,
your [Total Damage] for the battle goes up!

To increase your damage with
"Chains" and "Overkill,"
make good use of Reversal Mode!

The Reversal Gauge has been filled for you,
so try it out right away!
script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_03_script:
When an attack hits, there's a certain chance
of a Critical, which deals more damage!

Minds and Abilities can also raise
the Critical Rate and the Critical
damage multiplier!

In High Score Battles, whether you land a Critical
or not can change your score a lot!
script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_04_script:
Some skills apply Status Effects to the player characters
or enemies for a certain period!

The ones that shine in High Score Battles are
"ATK Up effects on allies"
and "DEF Down effects on enemies"!

To build Chains,
"Speed Up effects on allies"
and "Bind effects on enemies" are effective too!
script:e_ev_eq_560001_9i7vtj41_05_script:
Place a Statue with an Assist Skill
in your Team Leader's Assist Leader slot
(the green Assist slot)
to be able to use its "Assist Skill" in battle!

"Assist Skills" have all kinds of effects,
such as damaging enemies or healing allies!

After you use an "Assist Skill,"
the next turn is always yours!

That means you get turns in a row,
building Chains and increasing damage!
It's one of the essentials for a high score!

script:main_tutorial_00_script_text_jp:2: I don't recognize your face. Where are you from?
So I don't mind teaching you about those powers!

Now then, first, tell me about yourself.
...Hmm, hmm, I see.

Looks like you don't know anything.
Then I'll have you learn all sorts of things from now on!

...Hmm, hmm.
I see, so you're interested in mysterious powers.

Lately, bizarre things have been happening
all over around here...
I suppose you came after hearing the rumors?

I don't dislike that kind of curiosity.
We've only just met, but I like you.

It'll be good research for my manga, too.
I don't mind keeping you company for a little while.

Oh, right, I haven't introduced myself.
My name is Rohan Kishibe.

Manga needs reality, after all!
I want to observe you encountering mysterious powers for the first time.
script:main_tutorial_01_script_text_jp:-:
This is a Quest!
First, the very basics: let's try moving a Statue.

[Slide] across the screen
to move your character.

Quickly [Flick] the screen
to do a step.

[Tap] the red button at the bottom right of the screen
to make a normal attack.

Tap repeatedly or hold the button down
to make consecutive attacks.
script:main_tutorial_02_script_text_jp:-:
Hmm, not bad at all.
Next, don't you want to land a really sharp punch?

Use the blue button at the bottom right of the screen
to activate a [Skill].

A [Skill] lets you make a more powerful attack,
but you can't use it repeatedly.
After a certain amount of time, you can use it again.

Use the pink button on the right of the screen
to activate an [SP Skill].
An [SP Skill] is an attack even more powerful than a Skill.

However, each [SP Skill] can only be used a limited number of times,
so use them at the moment that counts.
script:main_tutorial_03_script_text_jp:-:
Looks like you've gotten used to fighting, so now go wild however you like.
Perfect timing, it seems some enemies have shown up!

Quickly [Flick] the screen
to do a step.

You can dodge enemy attacks with a step.
Use it well to create chances to attack.
script:main_tutorial_04_script_text_jp:4:
I knew my eyes didn't deceive me.
You seem to have a knack for this.

You... oh, I never asked your name.
No, you don't need to tell me.
I ended up reading more than just your name...!!
Hmm...! Looks like you're an interesting one.

You've got nothing better to do anyway, right?
Stick around a little longer.
script:main_tutorial_05_script_text_jp:-:
Next, let's use "Diamond Coins"
to do a Summon!
This time, let's try a special Statue Summon!
script:main_tutorial_06_script_text_jp:7: You got yourself a pretty good Statue.
While you're at it, you should put it on your "Team."

On the Team screen, you can put up to 3
Statues on your team.
Next, let's try battling with that Statue.

The Team Leader has
a "Leader Ability."

Leader Abilities have a positive effect on the whole team,
so check the effects when choosing.
script:main_tutorial_07_script_text_jp:-:
Let's try playing a Quest
with the team you built.
All kinds of Statues appear in Quests.

You might see Statue combinations that cross Part boundaries,
which you'd never normally get to see!?

You can choose a Support here.
You can take them along on the Quest.

That Statue's Leader Ability
takes effect during battle.
Choose a Support that suits the situation.
Well then, let's go cause some trouble.
script:main_tutorial_08_script_text_jp:-:
Oh, and this is just a personal thing,
but I'm getting a little tired of seeing Josuke's face.
How about swapping him for the one you just got?

Tap a character's face icon at the top left of the screen
to [Swap] to that character.

Red "Spirit," blue "Courage" and green "Wisdom"
form a three-way cycle, just like rock-paper-scissors.

White "Unity" and purple "Solitude"
each deal extra damage to the other.

Switch members wisely to match
your opponent's Battle Type.

If every member of your team is defeated,
it's Game Over.
script:main_tutorial_09_script_text_jp:-:
By the way, do you remember about Supports?
Let's see how a Support can help you.

You can use your Support's SP Skill.
Use it actively when you're in a pinch.
script:main_tutorial_10_script_text_jp:-:
All right, finally, I'll teach you my secret weapon.
With this, you'll enjoy Quests even more!

Tap the [Menacing Gauge] at the bottom of the screen
to power up your Statue temporarily.

You can activate it whenever even one letter has changed color,
and its effect depends on the Battle Type.

Green "Wisdom" removes skill wait times,
letting you activate skills one after another.

Whew, rambling on like this is tiring.
The rest is up to you. Go wild!
script:main_tutorial_11_script_text_jp:-: So, how was your first fight?

You're doing pretty well.
I'm sure you'll get used to fighting in no time.

Well... I've still got pages to finish,
so I think I'll get back to work.
From here on, do as you like.

I'm sure many "Bizarre Adventures"
await you out there!!!
script:main_tutorial_12_script_text_jp:8:
I've prepared Missions telling you what to do.
Try doing these first.
And then, fight alongside your comrades...!

Tutorial complete!
For more game tips, see the Beginner's Guide:
"News -> Other -> Beginner's Guide"

Completing "Missions" earns you rewards
such as items that help in the game.

They also serve as handy tips for playing,
so check them often and take them on!

"Cumulative" Missions have no deadline.
You earn rewards by reaching their goals.

"Limited Time" Missions give rewards
when you complete them within the set time.

At first, learn the basics of the game with "Cumulative Missions"
while earning Diamond Coins!!

Once you've earned rewards, don't forget
to check your Message Box!!

Build up lots of experience
together with your comrades...!

script:main_tutorial_18_script_text_jp:2:
Who are you? I've never seen you
in this town before. Did you come from somewhere else?

...I see.
So you came here because you admire gangsters.

The gangster's world isn't easy...
Do you have the resolve to fight?

From here on, you'll have to go through
all kinds of battles...
script:main_tutorial_19_script_text_jp:-:
All your effort training in Hamon is
useless, useless, USELESS!!

Can a monkey catch up to a human!?
To me, Dio, you are

...No. With conviction, nothing is impossible for humans!
Humans can grow! And I will prove it!
script:main_tutorial_20_script_text_jp:-:
For the ritual of casting you, a Hamon user,
into the dark abyss of "death"...
this Hamon is truly the most fitting!
H-Hamon... hundreds of times stronger than mine...
Into the bottomless abyss! Melt and flow away!
script:main_tutorial_21_script_text_jp:8:
In JoJo DR2, you can battle in famous scenes

Win the battles to come

Jotaro Kujo VS DIO
MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDAAA!

Without a moment's pause, the final attack!
The true, final time stop!

Within the next 9 seconds of stopped time!
I will settle this!

DIO's onslaught as he stops time! To overcome this crisis,
defeat DIO with a [Finisher SP Skill]...!
script:main_tutorial_22_script_text_jp:3: If he waits here like this for the morning sun, he'll turn to dust...

you lost... DIO...
One simple answer...
script:main_tutorial_23_script_text_jp:-:
...All right.
It seems you're not completely reckless.

I'm a member of Passione,
the gang organization that runs this area.

If you want to join the organization,
I could introduce you to a capo, but...

I can't drag you into this...
Do you truly have the resolve to throw yourself into battle!?
script:main_tutorial_24_script_text_jp:6: In this battle, you'll fight Kira (Kawajiri)...!

Don't let him press Killer Queen's switch!

No! This is the limit!
I'm pressing it!

I said that was all I wanted to ask...
but the situation has changed...

Giorno Giovanna, you lied!
So why did you lie?

Now I have no choice
but to make you tell me why...

Answer me. This questioning has already become torture.
script:main_tutorial_26_script_text_jp:-:

Why did you stop attacking me!?
Why don't you finish me off?

...Because you're a good person.

To wipe out gangsters who push drugs on children,
I have to become a gangster myself.

To take over this city, there's no other way
than to join the organization that rules it and rise to the top.
script:main_tutorial_27_script_text_jp:6:
I've seen your strength for myself!

pass the gang's entrance test...

But just being strong won't get you

You'll need to gather comrades who will fight alongside you.

Go through all kinds of battles with your comrades
and grow stronger!

If you do, I'm sure that someday

Morioh? Hmm... Oh,
the miso-pickled beef tongue is great.

Hmm... Haha, sorry.

script:r_ev2_400001_01_script_text_jp:-6:
(April 1999. The day I started high school,
I met two bizarre men.

My name is Koichi Hirose.
Well... not that you need to remember it...)

For Jozenji, you can take the No. 3 bus from over there.
If you wait a bit, it should come soon.

(The first man was him, Jotaro Kujo.
I found out later that he was 28,

and a marine adventurer by trade.
He's apparently famous in academia for his ecological surveys.

Somehow... he's wild and intimidating,
but smart, too... He's so cool...)

Against the BOSS,
unleash a barrage with [Reversal Mode]!

When the Reversal Gauge is full,
press [R] in the center of the screen to activate it!

And build a [Chain] with consecutive attacks
to unleash powerful attacks!

High school starts today...
I wonder what kind of people I'll meet...

That's weird... I just bumped into him...
...and my bag spilled everywhere...
Sorry. I wasn't looking where I was going.
(H-He's huge! He's gotta be over 190 cm!)

I'd like to ask you something...
Do you know a family in this town named Higashikata?
script:r_ev2_400001_02_script_text_jp:-6: Hey! You a freshman!? Show some respect!

Y-Yes! I'm Koichi Hirose, a freshman!
G-Good morning, sir!

I'm kinda scared of turtles, see...
Too scared to even touch 'em...
So I figured I'd try to get over it.
That ain't what I asked you!

Well, well... you're pretty tall
for a freshman, but...
Idiot! Who said you could dress like that!?

Before you go strutting around like that,
you gotta pay your respects to us first!

W-Wait, I'm not so good with
reptiles... They're s-scary...
What're you grinnin' about, you punk!?
I'm sorry! I didn't know, sir!

Plenty of guys have said "I didn't know"...
and the last place anyone saw 'em

was the hospital...
You want me to make you like this turtle...

We'll let you off easy today.
Leave that school jacket and those baggy pants here.
And your cash, too. Hand it over.

He brought it on himself.
If he doesn't want to get singled out,

Don't worry, those guys
ride a different bus.

What really gets me is that he can watch them
do that to a turtle and not even get mad.
Hey! Coward! Let's hear your name!

Chapter 1 cleared!
Daily Quests are now unlocked!

Get the items you need to enhance Statues
in Daily Quests!

Strengthen your team and take on the next chapter!
If you clear the next chapter...

you'll get a Statue Summon Ticket
and Diamond Coins!
What the hell are you doin'!?

It looks like the turtles in this pond
just woke up from hibernation, so I was watching them.

script:r_ev2_400002_00_script_text_jp:36:
Josuke? The "Jo" of "jobu" with the person radical,
and "suke" as in "help," also read "jo"? Jo and Jo, huh.

Josuke! From today on,
we're callin' you JoJo!
You sayin' this hairstyle looks like Sazae-san's!?
Huh!? N-Nobody said anything like that...
I heard you loud and clear, punk!

Just now... I'm sure of it...
Some kind of Stand appeared behind him.

Huh...? Th-That's weird...
The turtle's... the turtle's wound is healed!

And the cuts on the guy's face
from getting punched are healing, too!

His nose was split open and gushing blood,
and it's already healed!

B-But doesn't it look like it healed
kinda weird? His face looks different!

Thanks to you, I had to touch that turtle...
even though I didn't want to...
What're you gonna do about that, huh?

Hey! Strip already!
The bus is here!

Keep dawdlin' and we'll buzz off
that Astro Boy hair of yours, too!

Hey... You... What did you
just say about my hair!?

Anyone who trashes my hair and pisses me off...
I don't care who they are, I won't forgive 'em!
script:r_ev2_400002_01_script_text_jp:-8:
that he has a son in Japan: you.
The old man didn't know about it himself...

That damn geezer... After going on about how
"I'll love no one but my wife my whole life"...

he had an affair at 62... and now I've
found the son that came out of it, right here.

Oops... Pardon my language...
My name is Jotaro Kujo.

By blood, I guess that makes me your...
"nephew." Weird as that is...

...So that's the deal. Someday, one third
of the old man's fortune will go to you.

The old man's affair came out,
and the Joestar family is in an uproar...

I'm so sorry!
I've caused you all this trouble!

His mother's name is Tomoko. At the time, she was 21
and attending a university in Tokyo.

(What? This guy!? I came here ready to take
a punch from him in the old man's place...
and instead, he's apologizing to me?)
Your hair looks so cool today, too!

I'm not done talking...
Get rid of these girls.
Save your stupid hair talk for later.
Hey! What'd you say about my hair!?

He's lived in this town since birth.
In 1987, at the age of 4, he came down with a fever of unknown cause

and hovered between life and death for 50 days.
His father's name is...
(Good grief. What a pain of a job.)

Your father's name is Joseph Joestar.
He's currently 78, and the founder of Joestar Real Estate.

(! I've heard of him!
He's some huge real estate tycoon in America...)

He's still kicking, but when we did some digging
to prepare for dividing his estate, it turned out...
script:r_ev2_400002_02_script_text_jp:81:
(It's been a while...
since someone "stopped time" on me...)
Hey, it's Koichi, right? Let's go!

(The other bizarre man I met
was this guy, Josuke Higashikata.

He plays dumb, then suddenly snaps...
He's hard to figure out. His family situation seems complicated.)

(Josuke Higashikata... A strange guy.
And that Stand of his...

This hat...
It's been fixed...? This is...
"A Stand that restores what it destroys into a different shape"...

If my face or head had been in place
of this hat... That's a chilling thought...

I had two reasons for coming to see you.
The other one is...

No... If he ends up on our side,
he might turn out to be pretty reliable...
Aside from that baffling personality of his...)

you'll get a Statue Summon Ticket
and Diamond Coins!

Great rewards and tough enemies
await you in Event Quests!

this photo...
Something is lurking in this town.

Something... dangerous
is closing in around you.

Anyway, this doesn't concern you,
but I figured I'd show you the photo.
Ah! Whoa! Look at the time!

Oh, crap! If I'm late on my first day,
who knows what my mom'll do to me...

Hey, about that talk... once school's out,
I'll want to hear the whole thing!
script:r_ev2_400002_03_script_text_jp:52:
Clear this chapter
to unlock Event Quests!
script:r_ev2_400003_00_script_text_jp:55:
Unleashed upon Morioh:
Anjuro Katagiri, also known as Angelo.

Committing crime after crime,
he had spent 20 of his 34 years behind bars.
The worst criminal in the history of Japanese crime.
That Angelo was lurking in town, targeting Josuke Higashikata.

Angelo used his Stand ability
to kill Josuke's grandfather,
and now he's about to attack Josuke...

Can Josuke protect the town
from this dangerous man!?
I'm gonna ruin your life, your heart and your very existence.

I'll... I'll protect this town and my mom.
In his place... no matter what happens...
script:r_ev2_400003_01_script_text_jp:-7:
By the way... that cut on your lip...
That's from when I punched you the other day.

Can't your Stand
heal your own injuries?

But it's been 3 days, and he hasn't made a move.
What on earth is he waiting for?
This is the moment I've been waiting for.

This house is mine now!
You can't go out in the rain anymore!

Somebody boiled water
without us noticing...
And the faucet's been turned on...
Angelo's Stand has gotten into the house.

He wasn't waiting
for you to drink water.
My Stand can't heal my own wounds.

What if he gets inside your body
and eats his way out from the inside?

I'd die, I guess...
If he gets inside me, I lose.

You think you can trap my Stand
in a bottle again...?

Not happening again.
Josuke... I've got your ability all figured out now.

I'll just take my time
and wait for my chance!
script:r_ev2_400003_02_script_text_jp:-7:
I won! Just like I figured, Josuke!
I knew you'd bust through the wall and come into this room!

Got him.
It's a little gross, though. Sorry about that.

I tore up a rubber glove just now
and swallowed it...

If you clear the next chapter...

you'll get a Statue Summon Ticket
and Diamond Coins!

Angelo waited for rain, which gave his Stand the advantage,
and launched an attack on Josuke and the others.

Angelo's Stand got inside Josuke's body,
but Josuke's quick thinking let him catch it.
script:r_ev2_400004_01_script_text_jp:25:
Angelo...
Josuke... I'll leave the rest to you.

Wh-What!? What are you going to do!?
You bastaaards!

For all the people you killed,
including my grandpa!
script:r_ev2_400004_02_script_text_jp:-4:
