you were chasing, huh...

Dunno how you figured out
I was in this hospital, but...

...you sure made it all the way here...
I'm a little impressed.

All right, Highway Star!
I'm getting a lot better!

Just need "nourishment" from 2 or 3 more people with "abilities"
like these guys, and I'll be fully healed...

Hey, Akemi!
That peach is rotten. Peel me a different one.
How can you tell it's rotten?

Come to think of it, you're right...!!
I guess my nose suddenly got really sharp.
Heh... I can smell it real well... *sniff sniff*

Somebody here is "angry," huh...?
It's reeking of that stuff called "adrenaline"!

The "adrenaline" your body releases
when you get angry and worked up.
What're you mad about? Is it you, Reiko?
Huh? I'm not angry at all.

We're all just so happy
that you're feeling better, Yu!

That's right! We're super happy!
There's no way anyone's angry!!

You bastard... I'm gonna get over there, no matter what...
I'm gonna get over there and... you... I'm gonna

'Cause I can smell somebody
seriously ticked off here.
You bastard, you drank my IV medicine!?

You wouldn't beat up
an injured guy like me, would you...
That's not what a real man does, right?

...I figured you'd say that,
so I already healed you.

That's right... Once I heal you,
there's nothing cowardly about it at all, huh?

Who the hell is this kid!?
This is Yu's room!

You've got the wrong room,
you idiot!

Leave him...
Forget about a guy like that...

More importantly, looks like I'm
slowly getting better...
script:r_ev_00096_04_script_text_jp:1764:
Besides, I told you to run, and you went and walked
right into the enemy's trap. You complete idiot!
Let me make this clear: we're even!

Like I just put on brand-new underwear
on the morning of New Year's Day!

Uh, so, Rohan... A lot's happened,
but I, uh...

What an unwanted favor... I'd rather die
than be saved by the likes of you!
script:r_ev_00097_00_script_text_jp:1945:
On their journey to defeat DIO, the group
stops for the night in a town thick with fog.

The old woman who led them to the hotel
was the mother of the DIO assassin Polnareff defeated:

A hundred, a thousand, I can control them all!
Hyahahahaha hyahyahya!

All I need is to make the tiniest wound on your body!
Just the tiniest!

And then my Stand Justice
will kill you!

J. Geil's mother, Enyaba, has a Stand that can
control the dead and the wounded...!

Enyaba even takes control of Hol Horse, her son's partner,
and tries to kill him...!
And now the dangerous Enyaba sets her sights on Polnareff...!
This is the power of my Stand, Justice!

Each person has only one Stand! But!
Justice is a Stand of fog that controls corpses!
script:r_ev_00097_01_script_text_jp:4280:
Waaah! Polnareff!
Don't leave me behind!

Shut up, Hol Horse!
Have you forgotten what happened to Avdol!?

I've got no reason to save you!
Just die right there, you bastard!

You won't escape me, Polnareeeff!
I'll rip your brains right out!

I'll snap your spine in two!
I'll crush your balls flat!
script:r_ev_00098_00_script_text_jp:2649:
I don't think I'd lose fighting alone,
but if they so much as scratch me, I'm in trouble!

I'd end up with a hole in me like Hol Horse
and be under her control.
script:r_ev_00098_01_script_text_jp:9176:
Quit playing dumb.
We already know you're one of the Stand users
sent after us, you old hag.

Well? What's wrong?
Aren't you going to show us your Stand?

Oh, great... Now that I look, this room's a toilet!?
Why do I always get attacked in places like toilets!?

But the moment they come in,
my Chariot will, in a single breath,
slice four of them to pieces!!

Weeell now!
How about you clean the toilet for me...?
script:r_ev_00098_02_script_text_jp:7708:
Can a fist knock down fog!?
Can a sword cut fog!?

Can a gun destroy fog!?
It's useless! Useless! Kyakya kekeee!

Good grief.
There's no need to run...

I'll take down that Stand
before the old hag takes one more breath.
script:r_ev_00098_03_script_text_jp:-191:
Whaaat!? One more what!?
You stinking, rotten little punk!!

One breath, you say!? I'll take one right now...
...One...

So what does it matter where I licked!?
That's not important, is it!?
Huh? Where did you lick? I didn't quite catch that.

Who cares where!?
Just give me some medicine to disinfect my tongue already!
Just now, I thought I heard something like... toilet...

Pfft, pfft... Actually, we already know.
How could I not tease you about something this funny?

Ah! Don't tell me...
You already heard from Jotaro!

Dammit! Hmph, forget the medicine!
Dammit... Come on! Let's hurry on with the journey, Jotaro! Kakyoin!

Jotaro's Star Platinum has sucked in the head
of Justice, the fog, and is holding it down!

Well, well.
Looks like this old hag's head
is now full of that fog she loves so much.
script:r_ev_00099_00_script_text_jp:1377:
After a desperate battle, Jonathan defeated Dio,
who had become a vampire and attacked him...

Jonathan is relieved, but Zeppeli tells him
that Dio is still alive...

Jonathan trains in Hamon under Zeppeli
and masters the Sendo Hamon Overdrive!

And so the group heads for Windknight's Lot,
where Dio lurks...

People are at work...
The town seems all right for now.

But Dio is surely somewhere in this town,
surrounded by these steep mountains.
script:r_ev_00099_01_script_text_jp:1720:
Mr. Zeppeli, it's a child!
He seems to have made off with our bags.
Hm. A young purse-snatcher, it seems!

A clever one, though!
His theft flows right into his getaway!!
What are you two dawdling for!?
JoJo, shall we have that boy show us around town?
script:r_ev_00100_00_script_text_jp:-694:
Hm!? This boy is acting a little strange.
Was the Hamon too strong?

No, the boy isn't the only strange thing here!
Look around you!!

It seems we're the ones who were lured out
and neatly caught!

The sun has set...
Now it is time for your lives to set as well!!
script:r_ev_00100_01_script_text_jp:-817:
I... I've prepared myself
for this moment!

But still, it gives me a sick, black feeling!
I'm breaking out in a sweat!

Back then... he repaid Mr. Joestar's father's love
with a bloody betrayal.

That guy... That guy, of all people!!
As a human being, I can't let him get away with it...

So that is Dio... A cunning one, indeed.
He and his zombies cannot move about under the sun...

So he hypnotized a human child to lure us out
to the time and place that suit him best?

To think a man this cunning
would put on that mask!

Whatever it takes, that man
must be destroyed!

Zombies made from the knights' corpses!
Let's go, JoJo!!
script:r_ev_00100_02_script_text_jp:6894:
Dio Brando...
Personally, I know nothing of you...

But to the Stone Mask that awakened your brain,
I dare to say this:

Once this wound in my gut heals, every injury
JoJo gave me in that fire will be fully healed!

Come, witch doctor! I shall fumigate
this wound with your life!

You... Just how many lives
have you drained for that wound!?

Do you remember how many slices
of bread you've eaten in your life?
script:r_ev_00100_03_script_text_jp:-355: I'll pour it in! The Hamon of the sun!

then blowing a fanfare for me
would suit you far better!

Tarkus! Black Knight Bruford!!
There's no need for me to step in!

Come out and make these fools blow
a fanfare of screams!

Those zombies, both of them, are going for JoJo!!
N-no way! Not JoJo, the way he is now!

He can't win two against one!
If only blood would flow through this arm!!

Hey, Zeppeli, old man!
So I just gotta thaw out that frozen arm of yours, right!?

How's that!! Being dead weight
for you or Mr. Joestar...
He did it! The Hamon is traveling up Dio's arm!

I underestimated you.
I thought you'd be the type to run when it counted...

Save your thanks for when the fight's over
and we've made it out alive...

It seems your energy has something to do
with the flow of blood!

Therefore, if I freeze your very blood vessels,
you cannot send that energy!

You fool! I'll cave in your skull like smashing a jar,
arm and all!

Dio! I will crush
your ambitions!!

"Hamon"? A "breathing technique," you say?
If you want to blow on something...
script:r_ev_00101_00_script_text_jp:8802:
A Stand called Killer Queen,
with the power to turn anything it touches into a bomb...

Its user, Yoshikage Kira, had been
secretly killing in Morioh for many years.

Josuke and the others discovered that Kira was the murderer...
But before they could catch him, Kira used

Aya Tsuji's Stand ability, Cinderella,
to become someone else and escape...
script:r_ev_00101_01_script_text_jp:6109:
That's all the information we could gather.
It seems he's been very good at erasing evidence of his crimes.

Yoshikage Kira... What face and name
are you using now... and where are you...?

(People live their lives hiding
the depths of their hearts from "others."

But... can a person go their whole life
hiding their "true nature" from everyone forever?)

(Dammit! I want to reveal my, Yoshikage Kira's,
"true nature" to that woman on the far right...
I want that woman to hear the "depths of my heart"...

That I'd like to strangle
that slender neck of hers with these hands...

When it's "the time my nails grow,"
I can't hold back my feelings.
I must endure until I can settle down in peace...

Summer...
More tourists are coming to town, too...

I still can't even forge
this man's "handwriting" perfectly...)

Josuke Higashikata... Jotaro Kujo...
It's because of them that I'm in this mess...

I can't imagine he'll stay quiet...
He won't be able to hold back. He'll make a move.

On July 1st, Morioh held the official
opening of its beaches and rivers!

Tourists from the capital area and S City
are flooding in, and the town is buzzing!

This time of year, the town is full of fun!
How is everyone enjoying their summer?
script:r_ev_00101_02_script_text_jp:5666:
(D-Damn...
Confessing would be a mistake... They'd find me out...)

(You were trying to undo the buttons on my back, weren't you?
"I'm sorry for startling you"...?

Don't be! Lately, the way you act
makes my heart race so much...

And it's so exciting! I think I'm...
falling for you...)

Mom... getting undressed
in front of Dad... It's been a while...
Well, I made you some tea.

Am I a child born to
parents who love each other?
What are they doing? What is this?

Josuke Higashikata... Jotaro Kujo...
It's because of them that I'm in this mess...

You might be thinking
that this is a rare occurrence, but...

Oh, look at the time...
Maybe I'll go to bed soon.

(Open your "heart" to this woman.
Show her your "true nature," Yoshikage Kira.

Confess to her that you want
to strangle her neck.)
script:r_ev_00102_00_script_text_jp:-343:
Have a good day, honey...
Mmm♪

I wanted a goodbye kiss...
But I just know our hearts are connected...
One of these days, I'm going to seduce him for sure...

He used a shoehorn to put on his shoes.
He must have worn the 25.5 cm pair.
It's weird that there are shoes in two different sizes...

It's weird that Mom and Dad get along so well lately, too.
And he was gobbling up the shiitake he hates...

This is weird, too. Why...
is he writing his own name over and over again!?

Hayato! He left again
without even saying goodbye.

No matter how many times I look, it's "dirt" in a flowerpot.
Is that a bag of cat food he's carrying with it?
And then he goes into the closet...
Everybody's wearing hats. Is that a school rule...?

...
I have a bad feeling about this.

Oh! Honey! That's the wrong plate!
I set that aside because you don't like shiitake...!
Since when can you eat them!?

Hehe, but I'm so happy...
You're gobbling up my cooking...
You finally realized you were judging them before even trying them, didn't you?
script:r_ev_00102_01_script_text_jp:-426: (Lately... my "nails" have been growing fast again. Too fast.

The woman running her fingers through her well-kept, prized hair...
You've "escaped death"... For now, I'll hold back from "choosing.")

! Hey...
Why are you touching my bag...?
A pickpocket? A pervert? He's playing dumb.

...Oh, crap!
It's Morioh. This is our stop. Come on!

So my old man, every time I go out,
he secretly follows me and snoops around!
You party way too much at night.

It ticked me off so bad
that I shoplifted right in front of him on purpose!
And then I came straight over to your place!

For real!? Babe!
They're probably filing a missing person report right now!
script:r_ev_00102_02_script_text_jp:-576: Who the hell are you!? This is my room!

(Should I show it to someone?
Not Mom! She trusts him completely.

Besides, he's "not human"...
Could the police even catch someone like him?

Sooner or later, Mom and I will be killed.
What am I supposed to do!?)

in the baaath? "Hayato"!?
It's been a while since you and Dad...

(Wh-What's he doing here!?
If he finds this tape, I'm in trouble...)
By the way, I just remembered something.

This evening, I had work business near Jozenji,
the opposite direction from home, and I saw you there.

With a video camera!
What were you doing!?

(He just screamed...
And that expression... Now I know.

His reaction confirms it. This brat...
he saw me after all!

"Killing" this brat would draw attention.
That would be very bad...
But since he saw that, I have no choice!

I turned one of the brat's hairs into a "bomb."
Now if I just blow up his head a little...

it will look like he slipped in the bath and hit his head.
That kind of accident happens all the time...)

You're going to die!
Die, brat!

You're gonna kill me, too?
Even though I'm recording this on video!

I've been recording you the whole time... Your shoe sizes,
and you practicing your signature! I got it all!

There are other tapes, too!
In a place only I know about!

But if anything happens to me,
someone will find that place...!!

Don't you lay a hand on me!
Got it!?
And you won't touch Mom, either!

(Th-The man and the woman
he followed from the station! He...!)

He killed them and made them vanish! He's not human...
That thing disguised as Dad... isn't human!

Hm!...? What's that?
What's he holding in his hand?

C-Calm down...
Calm down and get your thoughts in order.
script:r_ev_00102_03_script_text_jp:6769:
For someone like you to try to dispose of Hayato...
What a foolish thing to do!
I'm thinking about what to do now...

Th-The Arrow moved on its own...
A-And pierced Yoshikage again...!!

There's no way out anymore...
You have no choice but to leave town... Yoshikage.

You know full well that I refuse
to live a life looking over my shoulder,

fearing whoever's chasing me,
never calm, never at peace!
I will never leave this town!
script:r_ev_00103_00_script_text_jp:-209:
Giorno told Bucciarati of his dream
to become a Gang-Star and make the city peaceful.

To take the gang's entrance test,
he goes to meet the capo, Polpo.

Giorno was told to bring back a lighter
without letting its flame go out for 24 hours.

An unexpected accident put out the flame, and when it was relit,
Polpo's Stand, Black Sabbath, attacked!

He defeated Black Sabbath and passed the lighter test,
becoming a member of the gang and one of Bucciarati's men.

After passing, Giorno killed Polpo,
who dragged innocent people into it, making it look like suicide.
script:r_ev_00103_01_script_text_jp:-413:
Come on, Fugooo... The weather's so nice out...
I can skip studying for just one day...
I'm just not feeling it today...
Hey, what's the big idea here!?
? What do you mean? It's strawberry cake.
I can see that it's strawberry cake!

It's not chocolate cake,
and it's not cheesecake, either.

That's not the point! There are FOUR slices!
Are you telling me to die!?

Idiot! Picking one thing
out of four is bad luck!

Picking out of five is fine!
Picking out of three is fine, too!

But if you pick out of four,
something bad's gonna happen!

Look, Narancia, you're admirable.
You never properly went to elementary school,
and it's not easy to say "teach me" on your own...

And you learned your multiplication tables
just fine, didn't you?

If you do it the way I taught you, you can do it.
You can do it...
6 times 5... six fives... six fives, uh... 30?

Yes! See, you can do it!
You're already halfway there!
Oh yeah! Six fives are 30! All right!
script:r_ev_00103_02_script_text_jp:-850:
Talking down to people isn't nice!
I'll kill you! I'm gonna kill you, Fugo!
You idiots! What are you doing!?

I brought the new member I told you about yesterday!
This is Giorno Giovanna!!

I'm Giorno Giovanna.
A pleasure to meet you.
Heh heh, did I get it right?

Are you mocking me, you punk!?
How many times do I have to teach you before you get it!?

You wrote six fives are 30,
so why'd the answer go below 30, you...

Aaand he snapped again.
Hey, Abbacchio, you gonna leave that cake? Or eat it?

What did you say...?
You called me rotten-brained...!
script:r_ev_00104_00_script_text_jp:2949:
Sorry, Fugo. I'll study really hard.
So teach me again, OK?
I'm the one who should apologize, Narancia.

No sense standing around. Have a seat.
Have some tea... and let's have a little chat...

I went out of my way to pour that for you,
and you said, "Thank you, I will."

You said you'd have some, so you're gonna drink it.
Or is it too lukewarm for your taste?

Or maybe you don't wanna drink it
because you don't wanna be one of us?

Hey, you guys! I'm the one who brought him here,
so be nice to him!
Mr. Bucciarati, there's a phone call for you.

Ah, got it.
You guys make sure to say hello to Giorno properly, understand?
script:r_ev_00104_01_script_text_jp:7084:
No way! Hey! That's gross!
He drank it! This guy actually drank it!
Quit fooling around, you guys. We're heading out.
You'll see if you follow me. Hurry up.

Bucciarati?
That phone call just now... did something happen?

No! There's no way he drank it!
Hey, how'd you do it!? Where'd you hide it!?

Did you really drink it!? Tell me!
Just me! Come on, tell me!

Who knows...
You guys keep your "abilities" secret too, don't you?

I turned one of my teeth into a jellyfish, whose body is 98% water,
and had it soak it all up.
I don't really understand it, but Giorno Giovanna...

seems to have some kind of talent
for winning people over.
script:r_ev_00104_02_script_text_jp:-809: Ooh! So heading out means a cruise! Sweet!

Hey, Bucciarati,
when did you get your hands on a yacht?

It doesn't matter why he died.
Polpo was a capo who did things that got him what he deserved...

But what does that have to do
with Capri?

The truth is, Polpo had a hidden fortune.
And it's worth... 10 billion lire!

I'm the only one who knows where it's hidden!
Because Polpo ordered me to hide it!

The 10 billion is ours.
With that money, I can become a capo!

Hey, Bucciarati! Come on already!
Can't you tell us where this boat is headed!?
All right. We're far enough from land now.
We're headed for Capri! Polpo has killed himself!
script:r_ev_tuto_e02_script_text_jp:-179: If he waits here like this for the morning sun, he'll turn to dust...

you lost... DIO...
One simple answer...
script:r_ev_tuto_e04_script_text_jp:-810:
What are you doing?
Giorno Giovanna!

Why did you stop attacking me!?
Why don't you finish me off?

...Because you're a good person.
A gangster, but a good person...

To wipe out gangsters who push drugs on children,
I have to become a gangster myself.

To take over this city, there's no other way
than to join the organization that rules it and rise to the top.
I'm going to become a Gang-Star!
script:r_ev_tuto_s00_script_text_jp:3583:
All your effort training in Hamon is
useless, useless, USELESS!!

Can a monkey catch up to a human!?
To me, Dio, you are

...No. With conviction, nothing is impossible for humans!
Humans can grow! And I will prove it!
script:r_ev_tuto_s01_script_text_jp:-353:
For the ritual of casting you, a Hamon user,
into the dark abyss of "death"...
this Hamon is truly the most fitting!
H-Hamon... hundreds of times stronger than mine...
Into the bottomless abyss! Melt and flow away!
script:r_ev_tuto_s02_script_text_jp:-169: MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDA MUDAAA!

Without a moment's pause, the final attack!
The true, final time stop!

Within the next 9 seconds of stopped time!
I will settle this!
script:r_ev_tuto_s03_script_text_jp:8829:
Jotaro! Stop time!
Don't let him press Killer Queen's switch!

No! This is the limit!
I'm pressing it!
script:r_ev_tuto_s04_script_text_jp:-651:
I said that was all I wanted to ask...
but the situation has changed...

Giorno Giovanna, you lied!
So why did you lie?

Now I have no choice
but to make you tell me why...

My name is Bruno Bucciarati.
Answer me. This questioning has already become torture.
script:sub_tutorial_00_script_text_jp:74:
Statues can raise their stats
by equipping "Minds."

Also, by equipping certain Minds
to specific Statues,

you can use "Mind Skills"
and "Mind SP Skills."

raising the Mind Level reduces the number
of turns needed before you can use them.

Each Mind has a Cost, and you can equip Minds
up to your Mind Capacity (CP).

Your max CP increases as you unlock
"CP Up" tiles on the Growth Tree.
script:sub_tutorial_01_script_text_jp:12:
Statues can raise their stats when you Enhance
them with "Minds" or "Enhance Items."
script:sub_tutorial_02_script_text_jp:-3:
The Growth Tree consumes specific items
to unlock a Statue's hidden power.

Raising the Skill Level reduces the number
of turns needed before you can use the Skill.
script:sub_tutorial_03_script_text_jp:-8:
In the Shop, you can buy
Diamond Coins and more.
script:sub_tutorial_04_script_text_jp:32:
Using the Support character of a mutually followed Friend
in battle earns you more Friend Points.
script:sub_tutorial_05_script_text_jp:30:
In My Town, you can have fun
interacting with other players.
script:sub_tutorial_06_script_text_jp:40:
Daily Quests make it easy
to collect Enhance Materials.

The rewards change by day of the week,
so check in every day!
script:sub_tutorial_07_script_text_jp:23:
These are Limited Time Quests.
You can earn a variety of Rewards.
script:sub_tutorial_08_script_text_jp:16:
In My Town, you can interact
with other players.
script:sub_tutorial_10_script_text_jp:39:
Here, you can spend "BP (Battle Points)"
to battle teams used by other players.
Giving up counts as an automatic loss.

In Arenas marked "AUTO Battle," the AI performs
every action in battle except "Give Up."

For details on the Arena,
please see Help.

In the Arena, you fight with your "Arena" team.
Set up your Arena team on the Team screen!

You earn points based on your battle results,
and compete for the top of the Ranking with them!
You can also "Swap" Statues during battle!

But once you Swap, an Interval begins!
You can't swap back to the same Statue right away, so be careful!

The team set as your Arena team will be randomly
selected as an opponent for other players.

When you're selected as another player's opponent,
you can earn Arena Points based on the result!

You can also give up a battle with the
"Give Up" button at the top center of the screen.
script:sub_tutorial_11_script_text_jp:53:
These 2 slots are reserved for a Skill Mind
and an SP Skill Mind, respectively.

Tap the lock to check the conditions
for unlocking an additional Mind slot.

Unlocking a slot adds a Mind slot to all your Statues,
so work toward them step by step.

Along with the extra Mind slots,
all Statues now have new CP tiles.

When equipping high-Cost Minds, don't forget
to unlock CP tiles on the Growth Tree!!
Make good use of them and enjoy battles even more!
script:sub_tutorial_12_script_text_jp:47: Try out the Assist Statue feature!

In the Assist Team, you can place
Statues you already own.

Statues set here can't
take part in battle,

but they boost the stats of the Statues
on your battle team.

By placing a Statue in your team Leader's
Assist Skill slot,
you can use its Assist Skill during battle!
For details on Assist Teams, please see Help.
script:sub_tutorial_13_script_text_jp:-1:
Awakening lets you raise the Rarity
of Statues you already own.

Tap a Statue to check
its Awakening conditions.

Once all conditions are met, consume Materials
and reduce its Boost count
to obtain a Statue of the next Rarity up.
script:sub_tutorial_14_script_text_jp:33:
"Mind Labyrinth" is a mode where you clear
randomly appearing Quests one after another.

The Labyrinth is divided into floors, and the deeper you go,
the better the Rewards you can earn.
You need "Mentality" to advance through the Labyrinth.

Mentality recovers by a set amount
at a fixed time every day.

If you run out of "Soul" while exploring, you'll lose
all the Clear Rewards you've earned so far,

so if it gets too hard to go on,
escape from the Labyrinth and bring your Rewards home.
script:sub_tutorial_15_script_text_jp:-8:
This is the Statue team for [Action Battle]!
It's used when you play [Action Battle].
script:sub_tutorial_16_script_text_jp:54:
This is the Mind team for [Action Battle]!
It's used when you play [Action Battle].
script:sub_tutorial_17_script_text_jp:40:
Enhancing a Mind raises its Level,
and its performance improves with each Level.

Raise your Minds' Levels too
to gain the upper hand in battle!

When you have too many Minds,
use Storage!

Press the "Move to Storage 1" button, then tap
the Minds you want to move and press OK.
script:sub_tutorial_18_script_text_jp:51:
Here, you can spend "BP (Battle Points)"
to battle teams used by other players.

In the Arena, you fight with your "Arena" team.
Set up your Arena team on the Team screen!

You earn points based on your battle results,
and compete for the top of the Ranking with them!

The team set as your Arena team will be randomly
selected as an opponent for other players.

When you're selected as another player's opponent,
you can earn Arena Points based on the result!

You can also give up a battle with the
"Give Up" button at the top right of the screen.
Giving up counts as an automatic loss.

For details on the Arena,
please see Help.
script:test_tutorial_00_script_text_jp:-:
Who are you? I've never seen you
in this town before. Did you come from somewhere else?

...I see.
So you came here because you admire gangsters.
The gangster world isn't so forgiving...

From here on, you'll have to go through
all kinds of battles...
script:test_tutorial_03_script_text_jp:-:
...All right.
It seems you're not completely reckless.

I'm a member of Passione,
the gang organization that runs this area.

If you want to join the organization,
I could introduce you to an Executive, but...

I can't drag you into this...
Do you truly have the resolve to throw yourself into battle!?
script:test_tutorial_05_script_text_jp:-:
I've seen your strength for myself!
And... your resolve, too...

With this, I'm sure you'll
pass the gang's entrance test...

But just being strong won't get you
to the top in the gangster's world!!
You'll need to gather comrades who will fight alongside you.
This time, let's try a special Statue Summon!
script:test_tutorial_06_script_text_jp:2: This time, let's try a special Statue Summon!
